title: say alyansa ya angimbita na kadederal
intro: Isipen pa ya akaamot ka ed silong na parehon atep a singa say panangiparungtal, balet ta manpipili kay sananey a katooran. Sayan pigura et nambilay ya asingger ed katuaan tan inkapropeta, balet ta inmarap ed saramay ag-angawat ed satan. Say istorya ra et sakey a seryoson pasakbay ya say inkaasingger labat ed inkatunong et agmakapangisalba ed sakey a kamarerwa ya mantraidor ed panagmatalek.
clues: Nanayam ak ed abung na sakey a propeta ya pinili nen Allah.
Amtak so katuaan ya ipupulong nen asawak, balet agko itan talagan panisiaan.
Tinaynan ko so talek to diad impibiang ko ed saray totoon ag to labay tan tinulongan ko ran sumpad sikato.
Siak so abitla a kaiba so asawa na sananey a propeta ya nantraidor met, bilang ehemplo parad saray agmananisia.
Say istoryak et nisalaysay ed Surah At-Tahrim bilang pasakbay ya say pikakaaro ed saray propeta et ag mangiter na proteksion.
Inatey ak a kaiba iray managgaway mauges nen dineral nen Allah iray totoo nen Lut, ya atilak ed saray atilak.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Say Asawa nen Propeta Lut
Si Asiya, say asawa nen Faraon
Say asawa nen Imran
Sarah, say asawa nen Propeta Ibrahim
Say asawa nen Al-Aziz

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Intraidor toy propeta diad impanulong tod saray agmananisia sumpad sikato
Ibantak ed ilog so sakey ya ugaw ya akakarga ed sakey a baskit pian nisalba
Kinerew dan ipaalagey so sakey a balitok a kilaw a baka legan ya anggapo so propeta
Inakusaan toy sakey a matunong a ministro na mauges tan impriso to
Indaulo toy sakey ya armada na elepante pian deralen so Kaaba
trial.answer: Intraidor toy propeta diad impanulong tod saray agmananisia sumpad sikato

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Saray atumba a syudad na totoo nen Lut
Say Kaban ya impaalagey diad silong na ganggan na Dios
Say apoy so amalemew ed si Ibrahim
Say ungib a salimbengan parad saray naugip a kalangweran
Say ilog ya kawalaan na basket na ugaw
location.answer: Saray atumba a syudad na totoo nen Lut

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Inatey a kaiba iray agmananisia anggaman akiasawa ed sakey a propeta
Nilaban a kaiba iray mananisia tan linmoob ed Paraiso a mareen
Ginawa ya lusek bilang tanda parad ontumbok iran kailalakan
Inakmon na dalin a walaan na angkakabaleg iran kayamanan
Naikdan na mamilagron anak nen masiken la
outcome.answer: Inatey a kaiba iray agmananisia anggaman akiasawa ed sakey a propeta

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
